name: Wayfinder
author: atendev
description: Combines each act's points into one unified path. With the Acts path length, each act has its own length and mix. Act 1, Build the deck: fights and card rewards drive growth, Elites come later and spread out, rest is generous. Act 2, The wilds: the most Unknowns and Shops, the widest Elite swing. Act 3, The gauntlet: the shortest and most Elite-dense act, with Elite pairs.
